cues: And your ear is astonishingly sensitive.
At one kilohertz, the faintest sound you can hear has a pressure swing of only about two times ten to the minus five pascals, one five thousand millionth of atmospheric pressure.
The air layers move about ten to the minus eleven metres.
That is smaller than an atom.
